Geothermal Heat in East Africa: Matching Industrial Demand, Resource Risk and Investment

East Africa's geothermal opportunity extends beyond electricity. Heat can support food processing, drying, horticulture and other productive activities, but a hot resource does not establish an industrial market. The investable proposition depends on matching temperature, location, operating hours and customer credit with a reservoir that can sustain delivery. StoneComms examines how governments and developers can test that proposition before committing to wells, pipes or industrial parks.
